headline: Hindustan Times discloses substantial acquisition of Digicontent Limited under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Hindustan Times Ltd filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Digicontent Limited, triggering takeover code reporting obligations.
detail: The disclosure filed with NSE is a Regulation 31(4) notification under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, which mandates public disclosure when a person or entity acquires or agrees to acquire shares or voting rights that cross prescribed thresholds. Hindustan Times Ltd's submission indicates the transaction has reached a milestone requiring regulatory announcement. The specific acquisition structure, consideration, and target shareholding percentage are not stated in the available disclosure extract.
